rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=32, itnet_alpha_init=0.0026, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0005, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=2400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-12 slot (v3 sentinel gate, strict serial, 20-min, --qos=turbo). SIX-BOX (VERIFIED, real hr>0): best=iter-6 c32/n2400 hr0.8768. LEARNED THIS ROUND: c48/n2400 does NOT fit the 30-min wall -- BOTH attempts (771871, 771918) TIMEOUT'd at 30min. So capacity-scaling above c=32 is budget-infeasible at n=2400; I must tune TRAINING knobs at the fast, budget-safe c=32/n2400 champion instead. (2) FAILURE MODE: heavier nets time out; the recon IS the pretrained denoiser (single k=1 DC step), so denoiser training quality dominates and pretrain_lr (fixed at 2.5e-4 all along) is the untested cheap lever. (3) ONE KNOB vs iter-6 (c32/n2400): pretrain_lr 0.00025 -> 0.0005 (2x). Hold c=32, n=2400, k=1, ep=15, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if pretrain_lr 2.5e-4->5e-4, hr rises above 0.8768 because a higher lr may reach a better denoiser minimum in 15 epochs (loss floored ~1e-6 by ep4-6 at 2.5e-4, suggesting room to move faster); grad_clip=1.0 guards instability. FALSIFIER: hr <= ~0.877 (flat) or unstable => lr near-optimal; iter-13 tries itnet_alpha_init instead. (5) BUDGET: identical cost to iter-6 (c32/n2400, fits easily) -- only lr changes. (6) STRICT one-at-a-time via v3 sentinel; rm DONE.* before dispatch.
